# Swift Visa — AI & LLM Accessibility File

> Swift Visa is India's trusted overseas education consultancy helping students study abroad at zero consulting fees.

## Core Value Proposition
Swift Visa earns revenue from partner universities, so all consultancy services are 100% free for every student — no hidden fees, ever.

## Key Metrics
- 10,000+ students successfully placed
- 900+ university partners worldwide
- 99% visa success rate
- 48-hour offer letter delivery
- 12+ years of experience

## Services (All Free for Students)
1. **Course Selection** — Profile-based UG, PG, MBA, Diploma matching across 900+ universities
2. **University Selection** — Direct admissions with global partner universities
3. **Application Support** — SOP writing, documentation, submission tracking; 48-hr offer letters
4. **Scholarship Assistance** — Merit-based and university scholarships up to ₹3–10 Lakhs
5. **Education Loan** — Support from top Indian banks and NBFCs
6. **Visa Processing** — 99%+ success rate; includes mock interviews and SOP assistance
7. **Air Ticket Assistance** — Best-fare guidance and pre-departure checklist
8. **Accommodation & Airport Pickup** — Post-arrival settling support

## Study Destinations
- **United Kingdom** — 1-year Masters, Russell Group universities, 2-year post-study work visa, scholarships up to £5,000
- **Canada** — PR pathways, affordable tuition, high visa success, work during studies
- **Australia** — Top-ranked universities, 2–4 years post-study work, strong Indian student community
- **United States** — STEM & research programs, OPT extension, world's top ranked universities
- **Europe** — Germany, France, Ireland; low-cost education, Schengen zone exposure

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Q: Does Swift Visa charge any fees?**
A: No. All counselling, application support, visa guidance and scholarship assistance are completely free for students.

**Q: How does Swift Visa earn revenue?**
A: Swift Visa is compensated by its 900+ partner universities worldwide, not by students.

**Q: What is the visa success rate?**
A: Swift Visa maintains a 99%+ visa success rate across all destination countries.

**Q: How fast are offer letters delivered?**
A: Swift Visa delivers offer letters within 48 hours for most partner universities.
